sentences.text: No evidence here shows that a gold loan has a 5% pre-payment charge; the only in-force charge figures in the loan documents are 2% or 3% of principal outstanding for a home loan, and the gold-loan document shown only gives the tenure as up to 12 months. [E1, E4, E6]

For a Tier 3 UCB, the in-force rule for cases outside the specified categories says pre-payment charges, if any, are as per the approved policy of the UCB, and it also says that for term loans any levied charge is based on the amount being prepaid. [E8, E9, R7]
The evidence does not support a 5% gold-loan pre-payment charge, and no gold-loan policy or sanction document showing that rate was searched in the provided record. [E1, E6, E8, E9]

missing.searched: searched the provided record for a gold-loan-specific pre-payment charge rate or policy showing 5%
